description: This file defines an abstract base class 'PromptManagementBase' and related data structures for managing prompt templates within a language model integration. It includes method signatures for compiling prompts, merging messages, and handling prompt templates asynchronously, tailored for extensibility in different implementations.

classes.name: PromptManagementClient
classes.description: TypedDict representing the prompt management data structure with optional prompt ID, prompt template messages, model info, and optional parameters.
